description: Albs Labs | Member of Technical Staff (Multiple Positions) | Freiburg, Germany | ONSITE | Full-time Albs is an AI research lab building real-time multimodal intelligence for machines, enabling them to see, hear, reason, and interact. We treat model architecture, inference, and runtime as one system. We are hiring several Staff- and Senior-level IC roles and are looking for experienced researchers and engineers, typically with a PhD and several years of research or industry experience, or an equivalent track record. We hire across the following areas: - LLM Post-Training (RLHF, preference optimization, evals) - Speech-to-Speech Models (incl. ASR and TTS) - LLM Pre-Training (incl. model architectures and optimizers) - Synthetic Data Generation (pipelines, filtering, data quality) Learn more and apply at: https://albslabs.com/careers
